description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing a True Random Number Generator (TRNG) for the NEORV32 hardware platform, including initialization, entropy retrieval, and power management.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_read_ctrl
methods.description: Reads the control register of the NEORV32 TRNG device.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_write_ctrl
methods.description: Writes to the control register of the NEORV32 TRNG device.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_get_entropy
methods.description: Retrieves entropy data from the TRNG device, filling the provided buffer.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_get_entropy_isr
methods.description: Interrupt-safe method to retrieve entropy data, optionally busy-waiting.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_init
methods.description: Initializes the TRNG device, checking hardware support and enabling it.

methods.name: neorv32_trng_pm_action
methods.description: Power management action handler for suspend/resume states.
